regions.name: Greenreach
regions.description: A quiet frontier of thatched villages, old roads, and woods that remember older names.

locations.name: Thornbury Village
locations.description: A market village of timber and stone. The guild board stands beside the well.

locations.name: The Old Road
locations.description: A moss-grown trade road. Wagons once crossed here; now only hoofprints and rumours.

locations.name: Whispering Wood
locations.description: Birch and bramble press close. Something moves between the trunks.

regions.name: Ashen March
regions.description: A grey frontier of burned fields, broken walls, and things that do not sleep.

locations.name: Ruined Watchtower
locations.description: A broken tower on a bald hill. Its beacon has been dark for a generation.

locations.name: The Ashen Gate
locations.description: A blackened gatehouse half-swallowed by the march. Cold air drifts through it.
